mathematica: Prepend[ Select[ Range[300], Reduce[Mod[3 - k^2, #] == 0, k, Integers] =!= False &], 1]  (* _Jean-François Alcover_, Sep 20 2012 *)
response.name: Numbers n such that 3 is a square mod n.
program: (Magma) [n: n in [1..300] | exists(t){x : x in ResidueClassRing(n) | x^2 eq 3}]; // _Vincenzo Librandi_, Feb 20 2016
xref: Includes the primes in A038874 and these (primes congruent to {1, 2, 3, 11} mod 12) are the prime factors of the terms in this sequence. Cf. A008784, A057126, A057127, A057128, A057129.
